name: text-word-ghost-slide
title: Word Ghost Reveal
description: Từ đầu tiên lướt vào từ rất xa (360 px), các từ sau quãng lướt ngắn dần (120, 60, 25, 12 px), tạo nhịp nhẹ.

moworks.author: takayu

options.distances: em each word slides in from the right ([13.8, 4.6, 2.3, 0.96, 0.46]; the last repeats)

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio ty-ghost, written here): Words slide in from the right with shrinking travel: 360, 120, 60, 25, 12 px (words 1–5, last value repeats), each 0.33 s expo.out (cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) with opacity 0 → 1, 150 ms apart from 0.3 s. Demo: 'make motion feel designed' (26 px, 4 words, first word accent); loop exit: fade 2.5–2.8 s; loop 3 s. Params: distances: quãng lướt từng từ (360 / 120 / 60 / 25 / 12 px) · duration (0.33 s) · stagger (0.15 s) · ease (expo.out).
